videos.overview: For the first time, the final seven designers are given the freedom to design whatever they want; on the grand outdoor runway of Franklin D. Roosevelt Four Freedoms State Park, their daring "freedom looks" will be unveiled, rain or shine.

videos.title: Double Bind
videos.overview: The designers are faced with one of their hardest tasks yet: a one-day challenge that forces them to create one runway look that showcases two opposing fashion styles.

videos.title: Let Me See Your Peacock!
videos.overview: The remaining all-stars must create show-stopping red-carpet menswear looks that fully embrace the trend toward the flamboyant; Emmy Award-winning actor Colman Domingo joins the judges to help determine whose look will be in and whose will be "fowl."

videos.title: The Sky's the Limit
videos.overview: The final four designers push themselves higher than ever for the Avant-Garde Challenge, inspired by the breathtaking views of Manhattan from the 91st floor of Summit One Vanderbilt; famed stylist Law Roach and Steven Kolb from the CFDA guest judge.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: In a "Project Runway" first, three all-star finalists race against the clock to complete eight finale-worthy looks in just eight days; with the pressure mounting, all these finalists are shining jewels, but only one will be crowned.

videos.title: New House; New Rules
videos.overview: Heidi Klum returns to host the competition series; twelve hopeful new designers are divided into two competing fashion houses and must create a look inspired by Disney princesses and villains.

videos.title: Feel the Burn
videos.overview: After a shake-up in the houses, the designers are challenged to create a multipurpose athleisure look that mixes fashion and function.

videos.title: Boring to Brilliant
videos.overview: As the competition between the two houses heats up, the designers must use their creative skills to transform boring fabric into fabulous fashion.

videos.title: Sew Elementary
videos.overview: The designers head back to school where they must create fashionable looks using unconventional materials before facing a shocking twist at the elimination.

videos.title: Complementary Couture
videos.overview: After a difficult elimination, the designers must regroup as they are tasked with creating a companion piece to their unconventional materials look from the previous challenge.

videos.title: Hit the Streets
videos.overview: The designers must step up their game as they are asked to create a streetwear look that speaks to their individual brand.

videos.title: Runway Rodeo
videos.overview: The designers saddle up for a wild ride as their next challenge requires them to create a modern take on western chic.

videos.title: Threads of Confidence
videos.overview: Working with real people as their clients, the designers must create looks for a night on the town that include a jaw-dropping reveal.

videos.title: Something Wicked
videos.overview: The designers are challenged with creating a design worthy of Oz! Meanwhile, friendships are tested when drama unfolds on the runway.

videos.title: See You on the Runway
videos.overview: In an epic finale, the final three designers must create a capsule collection to prove who deserves to win fashion's fiercest competition.

videos.title: 22 for Season 22
videos.overview: Heidi Klum returns to host twenty-two designers as they battle to win fashion's biggest prize. A jaw-dropping twist raises the stakes as the designers fight to secure a spot in the competition by presenting the judges with a signature look.

videos.title: Ready, Set, Redemption!
videos.overview: The designers have a second chance at a first impression as they are challenged to create a look that reflects their personal design style; in addition to the judges, the designers' fate will also be decided by some familiar faces.

videos.title: In It to Win It
videos.overview: The designers are divided into four fashion houses and challenged to create runway-worthy looks inspired by NFL teams; working together while maintaining their own creative voice proves to be difficult as emotions rise and bonds are tested.

videos.title: Catwalk on the Wild Side
videos.overview: In a series of head-to-head fashion battles, the designers create bold looks inspired by wild animals. Special guest models from Hulu's Get Real lineup bring the contestants' creations to life on the runway.

awards: Won 2 Primetime Emmys. 6 wins & 98 nominations total
